parsed.why: Adds an in-force 2025 birth-sex facility ban in state buildings, no state discrimination or hate-crime coverage, closed birth-certificate markers, and a worst-legislation ranking — a tier-1 local exposure over the 0.35 parent.

Broader facility statute covering airports, parks and jails with criminal-trespass exposure, closed licence and birth-certificate markers, an LGBTQ travel advisory, and a 'Do Not Travel' label with 3.7 trans women killed per 100k.

July 2026 low-risk ranking, gubernatorial veto of bathroom bills, employment protections and no documented local violence lift it above parent; youth-care bans, panic defence, weak hate-crime coverage and dissolved Pride cap it below reduced-risk tier.

No in-force facility ban (two cities protect use), hate-crime sentencing covers gender identity, court-upheld care ban is resident-facing; the Feb 2026 licence-marker closure mainly affects residents, leaving it near but slightly above parent.

Most-Protective tier: public-accommodations law covering hotels and shops, gender-neutral restrooms, shield law protecting visitors' care, GI hate-crime law, panic defence repealed — strong operating protections, but the hostile national entry and passport regime persists.
